\n 03 \u00b7 Spotlight\n

ATS \u00b7 WFG\u2019s AI layer for the agents

\n Products \u00b7 adoption \u00b7 enablement\n
\n

ATS has become a front-facing AI consultancy for our title agents, we believe the first in the industry, helping clients learn, adopt, and run AI while shipping external products that generate new business and revenue.

\n\n

3.1 Three products, live on the web

\n
\n \n \n

E-Remit

\n

Remittance & reconciliation automation at the policy level. Agents remit directly to WFG, no manual wires. Voice-first input was the standout reaction at ES26.

\n Beta TestingView live \u2192\n \n \n \n

FieldIQ

\n

Field sales intelligence: every field activity an agent performs, captured and turned into actionable data for agents and their management.

MyHomePrompts

Brand-voice content and AI guidance for agents and Realtors, engaging new prospects and keeping business through the full transaction.
